methodology: Starting from the frozen nginx/Apache combined baseline, each field is assessed only when every required non-baseline header for a template would be available. Header names are lowercase ASCII because HTTP names are case-insensitive. Exact header values are never retained in this report. Greedy selection is transparent and not mathematically optimal.

greedy_stop_reason: No remaining SAFE field produced a positive marginal observable-template gain under the conservative all-required-header rule.

request_body_counterfactual.note: The frozen inventory records 1,584 HTTP CVE templates with request-body semantics, but Shenlon's passive Detection IR deliberately does not model body matching. A numeric gain would overstate evidence; complete request-body logging is not recommended by default.

ja4_note: JA4 is enrichment for pivots and defensive-rule refinement. No Nuclei-derived CVE observability gain is assigned because this Detection IR has no JA4 requirement.
